title: with-resources
responsibility: Builds the argument vector for running a command through the Harness resource-admission CLI, applying validated priority and resource environment overrides without shell interpolation.

inputs.name: resourceArguments.args
inputs.description: Arguments in the form <priority> -- <command and arguments>, where priority is coding, agent-test, or environment.

inputs.name: resourceArguments.env
inputs.description: Environment values used to override the selected priority, CPU count, and memory MiB.

outputs.name: resourceArguments
outputs.description: Argument vector for `resources run`, with priority and resource limits followed by the requested command; no shell string is constructed.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws a Usage error unless a supported priority, `--` separator, and nonempty command are supplied.
